'''Odeph''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] who allied his tribe with [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro the Hutt]] for peace between the Hutts and the Evocii.

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], when the Evocii tribes were stealing shipments to spite the Hutts, Odeph tried to reason with them in returning Suudaa's metals, but he failed to do so.
